---
title: "Cheatsheet"
---

Every hook you reach for, on one screen. Copy a line, swap the strings, drop it in
`.claude/hooks/`. Each sheet links to the how-to that teaches it and the reference that
lists every option.

::: {.callout-tip title="Run any snippet"}
Save it to `.claude/hooks/x.py` and run `uvx capt-hook --hooks .claude/hooks test` to
exercise its inline tests.
:::

- [Hooks](hooks.qmd) — every primitive and condition, grouped by what you want to do
- [Matchers](matchers.qmd) — the AST matcher vocabulary for style rules
- [Workflows & state](workflows.qmd) — multi-step gates, session state, and signal scoring
